summary: Frontend-only retest of /checkout/seed_kitenge-5m-premium at a 420x900 mobile viewport, run with Playwright against the preview URL using a freshly registered TEST_ buyer. Everything requested passed. Product: 'Kitenge Premium Fabric (5m)' loads, and all 4 methods are shown (mpesa, airtel, tigo, bank). Price math is correct: TZS 75,000 + 2,250 = 77,250. Validation: the Pay button is disabled with empty fields, name only, and name+phone, and enabled once all 3 are filled. Bank path: POST /api/orders returned 200 with payment_method='bank' and buyer_phone 255754710139. POST /api/payments/selcom/checkout returned 200 with {ok:false, activation_pending:true, message:'Bank & card payments are being activated on our Selcom merchant account. Please use M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa or Airtel Money for now.'} (raw Selcom resultcode 403 'API endpoint enabled for the vendor (4036)'). An error toast showed that message. The URL stayed on /checkout/seed_kitenge-5m-premium, with no dead-page redirect. The selection auto-switched to M-Pesa (mpesa radio checked and highlighted, bank unchecked), and the Pay button was re-enabled. Recovery: clicking Pay Securely again without re-filling the form made POST /api/orders (mpesa, 200) and POST /api/payments/selcom/stk (200, ok:true, 'Wallet push successful', ref S20817590317), then navigated to /my-orders/order_bdfb79a92420. The M-Pesa path works.

minor.issue: When activation_pending is returned, the bank order already created (e.g. order_cdde3b5fdef7) stays as an orphaned pending order with payment_method='bank'. Consider cancelling it or marking it superseded, or checking bank availability before creating the order.
Still unauthenticated, and both trust the client-supplied amount (carried over from iteration 17).

ui_bugs.issue: Still not fixed from iteration 17: after the redirect to /my-orders/{id}, the scroll position is kept, so on mobile the page opens at the footer and the order card is off-screen.

integration_issues.issue: Retrying creates a second order. The first (bank) order is orphaned, so one buyer action produces 2 orders. Reuse the order_id (update payment_method) on retry.

action_items: LOW: On activation_pending, reuse or cancel the order already created, to avoid duplicate pending orders on the M-Pesa retry.
LOW: Scroll to top when navigating to /my-orders/{id}.
Optional UX: visually mark the Bank option as 'Coming soon' while Selcom activation is pending, so users don't hit the error first.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.tsx still prefills from localStorage 'bs_user', but auth persists under 'biz-salama-auth', so the prefill never happens.
Checkout.tsx buyer_email is still made up as `${phone}@biz-salama.co.tz`.
server.py activation_pending condition mixes `and`/`or` without parentheses. It works (the 'enabled for the vendor' check is the OR fallback), but add explicit parentheses for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Registered buyer TEST_Buyer R18 (+255755237435 / TestPass_123!). Created orders order_cdde3b5fdef7 (bank, pending) and order_bdfb79a92420 (mpesa). A real Selcom USSD push was sent to 0754710139 for TZS 77,250.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth by putting localStorage 'biz-salama-auth' = {state:{token,user,isAuthenticated:true},version:0}. Bank currently returns activation_pending (Selcom 4036). Once Selcom activates the vendor, retest that the bank redirect lands on a working hosted page.
rca of the issue: The Bank 404 is resolved by handling Selcom's 403/4036 gracefully. A real bank/card payment still depends on Selcom activating /v1/checkout/create-order for the vendor.
